Package br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.domain.structure

Class Court

java.lang.Object
br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.domain.structure.Court
public final class Court extends Object
A playing area of the gym, with the cameras mounted on it and the button that turns their recent footage into a highlight.

The court decides which camera a capture uses; it does not keep the highlights it produces. The operator may give it a display name and a sport, both free labels: no rule reads them, so the court serves whatever the gym plays without classifying it.

    • DEFAULT_CAPTURE_SECONDS

      public static final int DEFAULT_CAPTURE_SECONDS

      public Court(int number)

    • Court

      public Court(int number, Clock clock, Supplier<String> highlightIds)
      Builds a court that stamps its highlights with the given clock and ids, so the moment and identity of a capture can be chosen rather than taken from the machine.
      Parameters:
      number - the court's number in its gym, starting at 1
      clock - where a capture reads its moment from
      highlightIds - hands out one id per capture, in the order captures happen
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the number is not positive or a source is null

  • Method Details

    • installCamera

      public void installCamera(Camera camera)
      Mounts a camera on this court. The court checks only its own cameras; uniqueness across the gym is Gym.installCamera(int, Camera)'s job.
      Parameters:
      camera - the camera to mount
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the camera is null
      DuplicateCameraException - if a camera with the same id is already here

    • removeCamera

      public void removeCamera(Camera camera)
      Takes a camera off this court. The camera keeps its state and its buffer.
      Parameters:
      camera - the camera to take off
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the camera is not installed on this court

    • record

      public void record(Frame frame)
      Passes one second of footage to every camera on the court. Each camera decides for itself whether to keep it; one that is off drops it.
      Parameters:
      frame - the second that just went by

    • triggerCapture

      public Highlight triggerCapture()
      Presses the court's button: the first camera that is recording freezes its last 30 seconds into a clip, and the court stamps it as a highlight. The court does not keep the highlight; storing it is the caller's job.
      Returns:
      the new highlight, with no name yet
      Throws:
      NoActiveCameraException - if no camera on the court is recording
      EmptyBufferException - if that camera has not yet recorded 30 seconds
      ClipAssemblyException - if a stream camera could not write the clip file
